name: biome-format
description: Rewrites JavaScript, TypeScript, JSX and JSON with Biome once per batch of tool calls and at git pre-commit, only when a biome.json governs the file, using the consuming repo's own Biome config.

biome_format_enabled.title: Rewrite JS/TS/JSON after edits
biome_format_enabled.description: After each batch of tool calls, run Biome check --write over the JavaScript, TypeScript and JSON files it wrote

biome_format_lint_gitignored.title: Act on files git ignores
biome_format_lint_gitignored.description: By default the hook leaves a file the repository gitignores alone: it is not rewritten or linted, since a rewrite of an ignored file has no git checkout to undo it. Set true to act on gitignored files too. A tracked file that matches an ignore pattern is always in scope.

biome_format_end_of_turn.title: Check JS/TS/JSON in uncommitted changes at turn end
biome_format_end_of_turn.description: At the end of each turn, run the pre-commit Biome check over the lines changed since the last commit and hand any findings back so they are fixed before the turn ends, at most once per turn. Nothing is rewritten. Off by default.
